Patient Portal -> Telehealth Service: POST /api/sessions/join, 6. Telehealth Service -> Zoom Healthcare API: POST /meetings, 7. Zoom API -> Telehealth Service: {meeting_id, join_url, host_url}, 8. Telehealth Service -> Patient Portal: {join_url} -> Patient enters virtual waiting room, 9. Provider EHR -> Telehealth Service: Provider joins as host via host_url, 10. Telehealth Service: Video session active, recording with consent stored to Azure Blob encrypted
